name: Drip Button
description: A GSAP button hover effect where paint melts off the button: it sags along the edge and runs down in a few uneven drips, the longest keep creeping and shedding drops, and it all climbs back up on mouse leave. Gooey SVG filter, any colour, any size.

props.name: color
props.description: Paint colour: the button and its drips.

props.name: drips
props.description: Number of drips. Shallow sags along the edge are added between them.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the drips to run down.

props.name: drops
props.description: Drops keep falling from the two longest drips while hovered.

props.name: seed
props.description: Changes the drip pattern (positions, widths, lengths).

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px. The paint runs only from the straight part of the edge.

props.name: href
props.description: Renders a link instead of a button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the button: padding, font, size.
